thought.text: Another harness podman glitch. Let me check if the script was created and retry:

reasoning_content: The harness's podman connection failure is recurring. These are temporary infrastructure glitches, and commands sometimes fail with exit code 125. Let's wait a bit and then retry the script. Also, we should check whether the file was actually created (the heredoc might have been written, and it might just be that the bash invocation failed).

action.command: sleep 10; ls -la /tmp/full_auth.sh 2>&1; cat /tmp/full-auth.out 2>/dev/null; echo "---retry---"; bash /tmp/full_auth.sh 2>&1 | tail -12

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "sleep 10; ls -la /tmp/full_auth.sh 2>&1; cat /tmp/full-auth.out 2>/dev/null; echo \"---retry---\"; bash /tmp/full_auth.sh 2>&1 | tail -12", "summary": "Retry full auth flow test"}
